content.body: The German Rifle Grenadier employed a regular infantry rifle and a cup launched rifle grenade of the high explosive fragmentation type. It was an anti-personel weapon and not an anti-armour weapon.
content.brief: Special Equipment: GewSprGr.30 HE Grenade Explosive: 700g (each grenade) Range: 250m Included Weapons: 7.9mm Kar.98k Mauser rifle 10 x HE rifle grenades 1 x combat knife
content.title: GRENADIER INFANTRY
